Technical field

The present invention relates to semiconductor integrated circuit, and more particularly, to the semiconductor for being suitable for power supply noise reduction Integrated circuit.

Background technology

In semiconductor integrated circuit, there are following problems：When in the signal wire for the data transfer between transceiver On when there is power supply noise, it is impossible to perform the data transfer between transceiver exactly.In order to reduce power supply noise, require Reduce the impedance of signal wire.

Therefore, there has been provided the countermeasure of such as ODT (terminal on piece) technology reduces the data receiver for transceiver Signal wire on power supply noise (JEDEC standard, DDR2SDRAM specifications JESD79-2E (JESD79-2D versions), 2008 4 Month, JEDEC solid state technologies association).Specifically, the bidirectional signal line for the bi-directionally sent data between transceiver is equipped with Terminating circuit, in each transceiver, the terminating circuit cuts through ODT functions when receiving data, and is cut when not receiving data Disconnected ODT functions.
